summary: A six-structure local VASP micro-NEB path replacing the under-resolved ML image 12-to-14 segment has been built and passed numeric geometry plus VTST POSCAR-path checks; the required one-step pilot package remains unsubmitted pending user approval of the actual path.

payload.one_executable_step: After explicit approval of the displayed concrete path, accept the checksum-bound path review, run the neb_pilot preflight and execution gate, and submit only the one-step pilot.
payload.submission_boundary: Do not submit the pilot before concrete path approval. Do not automatically submit the formal micro-NEB unless the same-path pilot is LSF DONE and passes the canonical pilot validator. No automatic retry, CI-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action is authorized.
done_when: The user accepts or rejects the displayed six-structure local path.
If accepted, the one-step pilot is submitted through a current hash-bound gate.
